title: Week in Orbit
summary: The space and defense sectors are navigating a mix of launches, partnerships, and budget shifts, with SpaceX's rideshare program facing scrutiny. Meanwhile, emerging players are making strides in satellite technology and lunar exploration.

themes.title: SpaceX's Rideshare Dilemma
themes.body: SpaceX's Transporter-17 launch comes amid growing concerns over the sustainability of its rideshare program. The pressure is on as competition heats up and budget allocations shift.

themes.title: New Players in Satellite Tech
themes.body: Simera Sense's involvement with the Canary Islands constellation signals a fresh wave of interest in satellite imaging capabilities. This could reshape the competitive landscape as smaller firms vie for attention.

themes.title: Defense Budget Boost
themes.body: The FY27 budget markup's $1.4 billion increase for space resilience underscores a commitment to strengthening national security in the cosmos. Expect this to fuel further innovation and partnerships in the sector.

themes.title: Lunar Landers and Recovery
themes.body: Blue Origin's ongoing work on lunar landers post-New Glenn explosion highlights the challenges of space exploration. The company’s resilience in the face of setbacks may pay dividends as lunar missions ramp up.
